summary: Warm illustrated page of 7 sections: a head with spot illustration, a pink wavy band with a follow-the-sun world map, a people-first block with three stats, six values, a community video, six leaders and awards, a news carousel and a closing illustration call-to-action. Needs a world map or location hubs, three culture figures, six leader photos and awards.
